basis: Run 37800877872 completed successfully on macos-15 ARM64 using controlled guest scope, no metadata fixture, and resource diagnostics disabled.

The acceptance receipt binds CI development run 37790643945/artifact 11556064167, source e7b7dc1ecae946369cebb482915faf7ef792c692, unpublished version 0.2.414, and identical before/after tree SHA-256 550863c8547660fb27bfe2f76ebe58f165f73d0827990c5710ffd8894d0d7046.

All 18 selected target entries pass, with zero target failures. The exact run's package, browser, and guest resource journals each end admitted=true, resourceInvalid=false, exitCode=0, decision=valid, and their run IDs match 37800877872-1.

The receipt and all three journals in the flat raw bundle match the original downloaded artifact-checkout copies byte-for-byte. The two retained screenshots establish guest-panel/page context, not SEO result pixels.

At the bound source commit, the driver uses an owned native side panel, trusted UI clicks, live public-tab DOM oracles, clipboard readback, exact social-tag comparison, and restores the controlled page source before writing the final receipt.
limits: The receipt retains booleans, counts, and selected public titles, not raw DOM values or clipboard bytes; screenshots do not show the SEO pane. Review can confirm bound driver predicates and outcome, not reconstruct every underlying byte.
A normal successful receipt does not exercise interruption durability, and this review does not close D183.
The run proves this controlled ARM lane executed successfully; it does not establish an architecture cause for separate Intel admission failures.
